english.title: Induce or procure person to apply for proxy at election without applying for cancellation of previous proxy
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were guilty of an illegal practice in that you knowingly induced or procured a person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), to apply for another person, namely **(..SPECIFY APPOINTEE..), to be appointed as

(A)_[his]_
(B)_[her]_

proxy to vote for

(C)_[himself]_
(D)_[herself]_

at

(E)_[a parliamentary election]_
(F)_[parliamentary elections]_

in the constituency of **(..SPECIFY CONSTITUENCY..) without

(G)_[applying for the cancellation of a previous appointment of a third person, namely **(..SPECIFY THIRD PERSON..), then in force in respect of that constituency]_
(H)_[applying for the cancellation of a previous appointment of a third person, namely **(..SPECIFY THIRD PERSON..), then in force in respect of another constituency, namely **(..SPECIFY OTHER CONSTITUENCY..)]_
(I)_[withdrawing a pending application for such an appointment in respect of that constituency]_
(J)_[withdrawing a pending application for such an appointment in respect of another constituency, namely **(..SPECIFY OTHER CONSTITUENCY..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 61(2)(d), (5) and (7) and 169 of the Representation of the People Act 1983.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location knowingly
induced or procured a person to apply for another person to be appointed as his or her proxy
to vote for himself or herself at a parliamentary election or parliamentary elections in a constituency
without applying for the cancellation of a previous appointment of a third person then in force in respect of that or another constituency or
withdrawing a pending application for such an appointment in respect of that or another constituency

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
61(7) An offence under this section shall be an illegal practice but -
(a) the court before whom a person is convicted of any such offence may, if they think it just in the special circumstances of the case, mitigate or entirely remit any incapacity imposed by virtue of section 173; and (b) a candidate shall not be liable, nor shall his election be avoided, for an illegal practice under this section of any agent of his other than an offence under subsection (5) above.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex - see section 176

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
